title: Yellowed Flaky German Buns Bao
description: Sweet and flaky German buns filled with char-grill-yang and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, wrapped in banana leaves.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, and char-grill-yang powder.
Add melted butter, egg, and milk to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and wrap each disk in a banana leaf.
Place the wrapped buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a little bit of melted butter.
Bake the buns for 15-20 minutes or until they are golden brown.
